name: Dolcezza
description: A popular pizzeria and grill restaurant in Bastos known for handmade pizzas, grilled dishes, natural juices and Italian-style gelato.
bonASavoir: Dolcezza combines Italian pizza-making with Cameroonian flavors. Pizzas start around 7,500 FCFA, while grilled dishes such as fish and chicken are available from around 3,500 to 5,000 FCFA.
